name: garch.control
title: Default SUMSL tolerances. abstol, reltol, and xtol are powers of double epsilon.

origin.description: Default SUMSL tolerances. abstol, reltol, and xtol are powers of double epsilon.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Default SUMSL tolerances. abstol, reltol, and xtol are powers of double epsilon.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
g <- garch.control()
paste(g$maxiter, cell(g$trace), g$grad, cell(g$abstol), cell(g$reltol), cell(g$xtol), cell(g$falsetol), sep = "|")

translation.description: Default SUMSL tolerances. abstol, reltol, and xtol are powers of double epsilon.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

translation.details: Default SUMSL tolerances. abstol, reltol, and xtol are powers of double epsilon.

translation.example:
g = garch_control()
